page.overview:
Who is Crime Wave Clyde?

Crime Wave Clyde is a character who only appears in the The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3 episode "Crimes R Us."

Crime Wave Clyde is from Earth, where he had been sentenced to 12,423 years with no parole due to his extensive criminal record.

Crime Wave Clyde plays a major role in "Crimes R Us." Here, King Koopa and his Koopalings travel to Clyde's prison on the Doom Ship, where he is taken to by Bully Koopa. Following King Koopa's request, Clyde agrees to teach the Koopalings everything that he knows about crime to help them become expert criminals. King Koopa, crossing his fingers behind his back, tells Clyde that he can keep half of whatever they steal.

The first lesson Clyde gives to the Koopalings is bank robbery. After receiving a crash course from Clyde, the Koopalings raid the First Mushroom Bank, but are foiled by Mario and Luigi in the process.
